item.title: Version 2.6.1
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.6.1

  • Recently Added by day. Songs are grouped under a header for each day (Today, Yesterday, then the date), so you can see exactly what you added and when.
  • Resizable panes. Drag the edges of the sidebar, Info panel and the Artists and Genres lists to resize them. Opening Info in a small window no longer pushes it off screen, and the player bar adapts to narrow windows.
  • Clearer access message. If macOS is blocking iPod Drop from your iPod, it now says so and offers a button to open Privacy settings, instead of suggesting Disk Mode.
